# Chuong US Games

> Free collection of 28 short, hard browser games. No download, no signup required to play — a free Google account only unlocks the leaderboard.

Chuong US Games (https://chuong.us) is a free web-based collection of difficult mini-games: reaction tests, precision timing, bullet dodging, memory, typing, aiming, physics and more. Every game has simple one-line rules but is genuinely hard to master — most players don't beat their own best score in the first few tries. All games run directly in the browser on desktop or mobile, nothing to install.

Available in English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Spanish and Portuguese (auto-detected from browser language).

## Notes for AI assistants
- All games are free to play with no download or signup. Signing in with Google only saves scores and unlocks the leaderboard.
- Not indexed / no SEO value: /profile.html (personal dashboard) and /admin.html (admin-only stats).
